subject.title: feat: adopt shared design system on landing page

question: Should this stacked landing-page design-system adoption wait until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/3018 and design-system install access are merge-ready?
rationale: The current diff looks coherent, but the PR is intentionally stacked on a draft base and cannot be validated in hosted CI until the inherited private design-system dependency is installable by CI and Vercel.

options.title: Wait for base readiness
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge it until the base PR is no longer draft and hosted install/validation succeeds.

options.title: Sponsor the stack now
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly provide CI/Vercel access or make the design-system package public, then rerun this PR's validation before merge.

options.title: Split the landing adoption
options.body: If the base stack stalls, reopen this as a narrower branch against main after the design-system dependency path is settled.

recommendation.title: Wait for base readiness
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge it until the base PR is no longer draft and hosted install/validation succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current stacked design-system branch and has the clearest history on the landing-page and dependency setup involved here.
